description: List the cities Edgegap can deploy to. Pass application and version to see only the locations with capacity for that version right now. Use it to pick geo_coordinates for edgegap_deploy when you have no player IPs, or to tell a developer where their players can be served from. For the ping beacons game clients use to measure latency, see edgegap_list_ping_beacons.

application.description: With version: only locations with capacity for it now.

name: edgegap_list_locations
title: List where servers can run
